"""
Refinement: at variable pocket positions, is the CHEMICAL CLASS conserved even when identity is not?
If the pocket is functionally constrained, substitutions should be class-preserving.
Plus final figure (mammals only, n=10 orthologs).
"""
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:SERPINA6+AND+reviewed:true"
     "&format=json&size=100&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence")
seqs={f'{r["primaryAccession"]}|{r["organism"]["scientificName"]}':r["sequence"]["value"]
      for r in requests.get(url,timeout=120).json()["results"]}
HUM=[k for k in seqs if k.startswith("P08185")][0]; human=seqs[HUM]; OFF=22
B="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
L=B.strip().split("\n"); cols=L[0].split(); M62={}
for r_ in L[1:]:
    p=r_.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): M62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return M62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,gap=-10):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    S=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); S[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; S[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap
    T=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); T[0,1:]=2; T[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pr,cu=S[i-1],S[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=pr[j-1]+sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1]); u=pr[j]+gap; l=cu[j-1]+gap
            if d>=u and d>=l: cu[j]=d; T[i,j]=0
            elif u>=l: cu[j]=u; T[i,j]=1
            else: cu[j]=l; T[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; a=[];b=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        t=T[i,j]
        if t==0:a.append(s1[i-1]);b.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif t==1:a.append(s1[i-1]);b.append('-');i-=1
        else:a.append('-');b.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(a[::-1]),"".join(b[::-1])
others=[k for k in seqs if k!=HUM]; colmap={}
for k in others:
    a1,a2=nw(human,seqs[k]); hi=0
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': colmap.setdefault(hi,{})[k.split("|")[1]]=c2; hi+=1
def P(m): return m+OFF-1
MAM=[k.split("|")[1] for k in others if "Xenopus" not in k]
CLASS={**{a:'hydrophobic' for a in 'AVLIMFWPG'},**{a:'amide/acid' for a in 'NQDE'},
       **{a:'polar-OH' for a in 'STYC'},**{a:'basic' for a in 'KRH'}}
POCKET=[18,19,22,26,232,240,242,260,263,264,267,366,367,368,371]; RCL=list(range(327,352))
consM=np.zeros(len(human)); classM=np.zeros(len(human))
for i in range(len(human)):
    v=[colmap[i][s] for s in MAM if s in colmap.get(i,{}) and colmap[i][s]!='-']
    if v:
        consM[i]=100*sum(x==human[i] for x in v)/len(v)
        classM[i]=100*sum(CLASS.get(x)==CLASS.get(human[i]) for x in v)/len(v)
print("Pocket residues, mammals (n=10): identity vs chemical-class conservation")
for r in POCKET:
    print(f"  {human[P(r)]}{r:<4} identity {consM[P(r)]:5.1f}%   class({CLASS.get(human[P(r)])}) {classM[P(r)]:5.1f}%"
          f"   observed: {''.join(colmap[P(r)][s] for s in sorted(colmap[P(r)]) if s in MAM)}")
pk_id=np.array([consM[P(r)] for r in POCKET]); pk_cl=np.array([classM[P(r)] for r in POCKET])
bg_id=np.array([consM[P(r)] for r in range(1,len(human)-OFF+1) if r not in POCKET and not 327<=r<=351])
bg_cl=np.array([classM[P(r)] for r in range(1,len(human)-OFF+1) if r not in POCKET and not 327<=r<=351])
rc_id=np.array([consM[P(r)] for r in RCL])
def cd(a,b):
    g=sum(x>y for x in a for y in b); l=sum(x<y for x in a for y in b); return (g-l)/(len(a)*len(b))
u_i,p_i=stats.mannwhitneyu(pk_id,bg_id,alternative='greater')
u_c,p_c=stats.mannwhitneyu(pk_cl,bg_cl,alternative='greater')
u_r,p_r=stats.mannwhitneyu(rc_id,bg_id,alternative='less')
print(f"\nIDENTITY  pocket {pk_id.mean():.1f}% vs bg {bg_id.mean():.1f}%  p={p_i:.4f}  d={cd(pk_id,bg_id):+.3f}")
print(f"CLASS     pocket {pk_cl.mean():.1f}% vs bg {bg_cl.mean():.1f}%  p={p_c:.2e}  d={cd(pk_cl,bg_cl):+.3f}")
print(f"IDENTITY  RCL    {rc_id.mean():.1f}% vs bg {bg_id.mean():.1f}%  p={p_r:.2e}  d={cd(rc_id,bg_id):+.3f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
d=[pk_id,bg_id,rc_id]; bp=ax.boxplot(d,labels=['Pocket\n(n=15)',f'Background\n(n={len(bg_id)})','RCL\n(n=25)'],
    widths=.55,patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp['boxes'],['#2980b9','#bdc3c7','#f39c12']): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(.7)
for i,a in enumerate(d,1): ax.scatter(np.random.default_rng(1).normal(i,.06,len(a)),a,s=10,c='k',alpha=.35,zorder=3)
ax.set_ylabel("Sequence identity to human (%)"); ax.set_title(f"Identity\npocket p={p_i:.3f}, RCL p={p_r:.0e}",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
d2=[pk_cl,bg_cl]; bp=ax.boxplot(d2,labels=['Pocket\n(n=15)',f'Background\n(n={len(bg_cl)})'],
    widths=.5,patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp['boxes'],['#2980b9','#bdc3c7']): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(.7)
for i,a in enumerate(d2,1): ax.scatter(np.random.default_rng(2).normal(i,.06,len(a)),a,s=10,c='k',alpha=.35,zorder=3)
ax.set_ylabel("Chemical-class conservation (%)"); ax.set_title(f"Chemical class\npocket p={p_c:.1e}",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[2]
labs=[f"{human[P(r)]}{r}" for r in POCKET]
xx=np.arange(len(POCKET))
ax.bar(xx-0.2,[consM[P(r)] for r in POCKET],0.4,label='identity',color='#2980b9')
ax.bar(xx+0.2,[classM[P(r)] for r in POCKET],0.4,label='chemical class',color='#8e44ad')
ax.set_xticks(xx); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,rotation=60,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Conservation in 10 mammals (%)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax.set_title("Per-residue: identity vs class",fontsize=10)
fig.suptitle("Purifying selection on the CBG steroid pocket, 10 mammalian orthologs (Xenopus excluded)",y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
